function.name: matrix_multiply
function.description: This function multiplies two matrices represented by the 'left' and 'right' parameters, and stores the result in the 'out' parameter.

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: Pointer to the first matrix to be multiplied.

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: Pointer to the second matrix to be multiplied.

parameters.name: out
parameters.description: Pointer to the output matrix where the result of the multiplication is stored.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value but instead modifies the 'out' parameter to hold the result of the multiplication.

function.name: matrix_det
function.description: This function calculates and returns the determinant of a given matrix.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to the matrix for which the determinant is to be calculated.

function.return_type: REAL, which represents the determinant of the matrix

function.name: GdipCreateMatrix2
function.description: This function creates a matrix using the provided parameters and assigns it to the provided matrix pointer.

parameters.name: m11
parameters.description: The value for the first element of the first row in the matrix.

parameters.name: m12
parameters.description: The value for the second element of the first row in the matrix.

parameters.name: m21
parameters.description: The value for the first element of the second row in the matrix.

parameters.name: m22
parameters.description: The value for the second element of the second row in the matrix.

parameters.name: dx
parameters.description: The value for the first element of the third row in the matrix.

parameters.name: dy
parameters.description: The value for the second element of the third row in the matrix.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to a GpMatrix structure. This will be set to point to the newly created matrix.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. It returns 'InvalidParameter' if the matrix pointer is null, 'OutOfMemory' if memory allocation fails, and 'Ok' if the operation is successful.

function.name: GdipCreateMatrix3
function.description: This function creates a new matrix based on the given rectangle and points, and stores the result in the provided matrix pointer.

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: A pointer to the rectangle used to create the matrix.

parameters.name: pt
parameters.description: A pointer to the points used to create the matrix.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: A double pointer to a GpMatrix object where the result will be stored.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns Ok. If any of the input parameters is invalid, it returns InvalidParameter.

function.name: GdipCreateMatrix3I
function.description: This function converts the input parameters to floating point values and calls the GdipCreateMatrix3 function.

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: Pointer to a GpRect structure that specifies the rectangular area.

parameters.name: pt
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of three GpPoint structures that specify the points.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to a GpMatrix structure that receives the new matrix.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which indicates whether the function call was successful or not.

function.name: GdipCloneMatrix
function.description: This function clones a given matrix and returns the status of the operation.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: This is the matrix that will be cloned.

parameters.name: clone
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the cloned matrix.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. It can be Ok, InvalidParameter or OutOfMemory.

function.name: GdipCreateMatrix
function.description: This function creates a new matrix, initializes it to the identity matrix, and assigns it to the provided pointer.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to a GpMatrix. The function will allocate memory for a new GpMatrix and assign it to this pointer.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'InvalidParameter' if the input parameter is null, 'OutOfMemory' if memory allocation fails, and 'Ok' if the operation is successful.

function.name: GdipDeleteMatrix
function.description: This function deletes a matrix by freeing the memory allocated to it.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the matrix to be deleted.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'InvalidParameter' if the input is null, 'Ok' otherwise.

function.name: GdipGetMatrixElements
function.description: This function retrieves the elements of a matrix and copies them into an array.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: Pointer to the matrix from which elements are to be retrieved.

parameters.name: out
parameters.description: Pointer to an array where the retrieved matrix elements will be stored.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if successful, 'InvalidParameter' if either of the input parameters is NULL.

function.name: GdipInvertMatrix
function.description: This function inverts a given matrix. It optimizes inverting simple scaling and translation matrices. If the matrix cannot be inverted, it returns an error status.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: This is the matrix that will be inverted.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if the operation is successful, 'InvalidParameter' if the matrix cannot be inverted.

function.name: GdipIsMatrixInvertible
function.description: This function checks if a given matrix is invertible or not.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: This is the matrix to be checked for invertibility.

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a boolean variable where the result will be stored. The result will be TRUE if the matrix is invertible, and FALSE otherwise.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if the operation was successful, and 'InvalidParameter' if the input parameters are not valid.

function.name: GdipMultiplyMatrix
function.description: This function multiplies two matrices. The order of multiplication depends on the 'order' parameter.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: The first matrix to be multiplied.

parameters.name: matrix2
parameters.description: The second matrix to be multiplied.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: The order in which the matrices are to be multiplied. Can be either MatrixOrderAppend or MatrixOrderPrepend.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if the operation is successful, 'InvalidParameter' if either of the matrices is null or the order is not recognized.

function.name: GdipRotateMatrix
function.description: This function rotates a given matrix by a specified angle in a specified order.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: Pointer to the matrix to be rotated.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: The angle by which the matrix is to be rotated.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: The order in which the rotation is to be applied.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if the operation is successful, 'InvalidParameter' if the parameters are not valid.

function.name: GdipScaleMatrix
function.description: This function scales a matrix by given x and y factors according to the specified order.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: Pointer to the matrix to be scaled.

parameters.name: scaleX
parameters.description: The scaling factor in the x direction.

parameters.name: scaleY
parameters.description: The scaling factor in the y direction.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: The order in which to apply the scaling. Can be either MatrixOrderAppend or MatrixOrderPrepend.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if successful, 'InvalidParameter' if the input parameters are not valid.

function.name: GdipSetMatrixElements
function.description: This function sets the elements of a GpMatrix structure to the specified values.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: Pointer to the GpMatrix structure to be modified.

parameters.name: m11
parameters.description: Value to set for the first element of the matrix.

parameters.name: m12
parameters.description: Value to set for the second element of the matrix.

parameters.name: m21
parameters.description: Value to set for the third element of the matrix.

parameters.name: m22
parameters.description: Value to set for the fourth element of the matrix.

parameters.name: dx
parameters.description: Value to set for the fifth element of the matrix.

parameters.name: dy
parameters.description: Value to set for the sixth element of the matrix.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if successful, 'InvalidParameter' if the matrix pointer is null.

function.name: GdipShearMatrix
function.description: This function shears a matrix by the given x and y values, and multiplies the sheared matrix to the original matrix based on the specified order.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: Pointer to the matrix to be sheared.

parameters.name: shearX
parameters.description: The shear factor in the x direction.

parameters.name: shearY
parameters.description: The shear factor in the y direction.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: The order in which to apply the shear transformation. Can be either MatrixOrderAppend or MatrixOrderPrepend.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if successful, 'InvalidParameter' if the input parameters are not valid.

function.name: GdipTransformMatrixPoints
function.description: This function transforms the points in the array by applying the specified matrix.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the transformation matrix.

parameters.name: pts
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the array of points to be transformed.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: This represents the number of points in the array.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. It returns 'InvalidParameter' if the matrix or points are null or count is less than or equal to 0. Otherwise, it returns 'Ok'.

function.name: GdipTransformMatrixPointsI
function.description: This function transforms the points in the array by applying the specified matrix. It first checks if the count is less than or equal to 0, if true it returns InvalidParameter. It then allocates memory for a new array of points, if it fails it returns OutOfMemory. It then transforms the points using the GdipTransformMatrixPoints function. If the transformation is successful, it rounds the points and frees the allocated memory.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: A pointer to the matrix to be applied to the points.

parameters.name: pts
parameters.description: A pointer to the array of points to be transformed.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of points in the array.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. It can be Ok, InvalidParameter or OutOfMemory.

function.name: GdipTranslateMatrix
function.description: This function translates a matrix by the specified offsets along the x-axis and y-axis.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: Pointer to the matrix to be translated.

parameters.name: offsetX
parameters.description: Offset along the x-axis.

parameters.name: offsetY
parameters.description: Offset along the y-axis.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Order in which the translation is applied.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if successful, 'InvalidParameter' if parameters are not valid.

function.name: GdipVectorTransformMatrixPoints
function.description: This function transforms a set of points using the specified matrix.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: Pointer to the transformation matrix.

parameters.name: pts
parameters.description: Pointer to the array of points to be transformed.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of points in the array.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'InvalidParameter' if any of the parameters are invalid or 'Ok' if the operation is successful.

function.name: GdipVectorTransformMatrixPointsI
function.description: This function transforms a set of points using the specified matrix, and stores the result back into the original array of points. It first checks if the count is valid, then allocates memory for a temporary array of points. It then converts the integer points to floating point, performs the transformation, and rounds the results back to integers before storing them back into the original array. If any step fails, it returns an appropriate error status.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: Pointer to the transformation matrix to be used

parameters.name: pts
parameters.description: Pointer to the array of points to be transformed

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of points in the array

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. It can be Ok if the operation was successful, InvalidParameter if the count is less than or equal to zero, or OutOfMemory if memory allocation for the temporary array fails

function.name: GdipIsMatrixEqual
function.description: This function compares two matrices for equality.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: The first matrix to compare.

parameters.name: matrix2
parameters.description: The second matrix to compare.

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: Pointer to a BOOL where the result of the comparison is stored.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'InvalidParameter' if any of the parameters are NULL, otherwise returns 'Ok'.

function.name: GdipIsMatrixIdentity
function.description: This function checks if the provided matrix is an identity matrix.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: This is the matrix that will be checked.

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a BOOL where the result will be stored.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. If the parameters are valid and the operation is successful, it returns Ok. If either of the parameters is NULL, it returns InvalidParameter.
